test_navigate_to_licenses.title: Verify Admin > Licenses lands on the two licence tabs with Available selected

steps.action: Open Admin from the sidebar and click Licenses.
steps.expected: The page shows exactly two tabs, Available Licenses and Assigned Licenses, with Available Licenses selected.

test_default_layout.title: Verify the licence summary reconciles: Total equals Active plus Available plus Suspended

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and read the Total Licenses block.
steps.expected: Total Licenses, Active, Available and Suspended are all whole numbers.

steps.action: Add Active, Available and Suspended.
steps.expected: The sum equals Total Licenses.

test_total_licenses_widget_visible.title: Verify Total Licenses equals the Quantity column of the Available table

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and read Total Licenses.
steps.expected: A whole number.

steps.action: Add the Quantity column of every row on the Available Licenses tab.
steps.expected: The sum equals Total Licenses, and the Available and Active columns add up to the summary's Available and Active.

test_license_counts_displayed.title: Verify every feature row's Available and Active fit inside its Quantity

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and read each row of the Available Licenses table.
steps.expected: Quantity, Available and Active are whole numbers on every row.

steps.action: Compare the columns row by row.
steps.expected: Available plus Active never exceeds Quantity, and neither is negative.

test_counts_persist_after_refresh.title: Verify the licence summary reads the same numbers after a page reload

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and note Total, Active, Available and Suspended.
steps.expected: Four whole numbers.

steps.action: Reload the browser page and open Admin > Licenses again.
steps.expected: The four numbers are the same as before the reload.

test_available_tab_is_default.title: Verify Available Licenses is the selected tab on landing and Assigned is not

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses without clicking a tab.
steps.expected: The Available Licenses tab is selected and the Assigned Licenses tab is not.

steps.action: Read the table headers.
steps.expected: Feature, Quantity, Available, Active (the Available table).

test_switch_between_tabs.title: Verify switching tabs moves the selection and swaps the table

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and click Assigned Licenses.
steps.expected: Assigned Licenses is selected, Available Licenses is not, and the table headers are the Assigned columns (No., Site / Device, License Item(SKU), Quantity, Issue Date, Expiry Date, License Key, Status).

steps.action: Click Available Licenses.
steps.expected: The selection returns to Available Licenses and the headers are Feature, Quantity, Available, Active again.

test_available_tab_displays_feature_list.title: Verify the Available table lists named features, not the No Data row

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses on the Available Licenses tab.
steps.expected: At least one row with a feature name and three whole numbers; no row reads No Data!.

steps.action: Read the feature names.
steps.expected: Every name is non-empty and each row is unique in full.

test_available_tab_columns.title: Verify the Available Licenses table has exactly the columns Feature, Quantity, Available, Active

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses on the Available Licenses tab and read the column headers.
steps.expected: Feature, Quantity, Available, Active, in that order and nothing else.

test_available_tab_retains_state_after_n.title: Verify the Available table shows the same rows after leaving for Views and coming back

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and note the Available Licenses rows.
steps.expected: At least one feature row.

steps.action: Click Views in the sidebar, then open Admin > Licenses again.
steps.expected: Available Licenses is selected and the rows read the same as before.

test_search_bar_visible.title: Verify the search box is empty, says what it searches, and takes text

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and read the search box.
steps.expected: It is empty and its placeholder reads 'Search by feature, availability.'.

steps.action: Type a word into it.
steps.expected: The box holds the word.

test_license_module_accessible_after_ref.title: Verify three reloads in a row leave the licence summary unchanged

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and note the summary numbers.
steps.expected: Four whole numbers.

steps.action: Reload the page and open Admin > Licenses again, three times.
steps.expected: The summary reads the same numbers after each reload.
